Un clic au démarrage, une roue affaissée: A clicking sound when starting, a collapsed wheel or an unusual light helps ALF review intervention options.
Un doute sur votre situation ou sur le t: Do you have any doubts about your situation or the transport of your vehicle? Tell us your need to know the options.
Un démarreur qui clique ou des éclairage: A clicking starter or dim lights can signal a dead battery. Starting assistance may be considered depending on the model and condition of the vehicle.
Un démarreur silencieux et un tableau de: A quiet starter and a dim dashboard are useful clues to communicate. Starting assistance depends on the vehicle.

Un nom de rue, un repère ou une entrée d: A street name, landmark or parking entrance helps locate the vehicle on the first call.
Un porteur et un ensemble avec remorque: A carrier and a combination with trailer require a different evaluation. Describe the setup on the call.
Un porteur immobilisé sur un site logist: A carrier immobilized on a logistics site and a combination with a trailer require different means. The safety of the location and the nature of the breakdown are part of the assessment.
Un tableau de bord qui s’éteint au démar: A dashboard that turns off when starting, an unusual noise or a red light are useful information. On-site intervention depends on the problem and the security of the location.

Un véhicule dont le moteur s’est arrêté: A vehicle whose engine has stopped or whose steering or wheels are locked may require towing. Point out the particularities of an automatic, electric or hybrid model during the call.
Un véhicule peut devoir quitter un parki: A vehicle may have to leave a parking lot, the area around a closed workshop or a professional site. Preparing access at departure and arrival allows you to determine the appropriate means.

Une batterie déchargée et un véhicule im: A discharged battery and a vehicle that is impossible to move do not require the same means. Describe the problem so ALF can consider an on-site intervention or transfer.
Une batterie déchargée, un défaut au dém: A discharged battery, a starting fault or a damaged tire can immobilize a two-wheeler. Leave the motorcycle in a stable location away from traffic if it is safe to do so.
Une crevaison peut nécessiter la pose d’: A flat tire may require the installation of a compatible spare wheel if the vehicle and location permit. Avoid any handling at the edge of a busy lane.
Une demande précise permet d’étudier le: A precise request allows us to study the route, access and delivery of the vehicle before establishing the quote.
